Mali.title: Malian army and Russian fighters retake strategic city of Kidal
Mali.summary: The Malian army and Russian fighters retake the strategic city of Kidal The Malian army announced its entry into the strategic city of Kidal, in the north of the country, which had been taken in April by Tuareg separatists who announced their withdrawal earlier Tuesday, as the military advanced . “We have just arrived in Kidal ahead of schedule,” a staff officer told AFP, information confirmed by a second officer.

Mali.title: Mali: The army recaptures Kidal after the withdrawal of the Fla rebels
Mali.summary: According to available evidence, by the end of April, the city had come under the control of the Fla and its allies in the Al-Qaeda-affiliated Support Group for Islam and Muslims (JNIM), thanks to a series of coordinated attacks against army positions in several localities in the country Five months after losing it, the Malian army regained its footing in Kidal, in the north of the country.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Securing the national territory: the FAMa are strengthening their system in Kidal
Mali.summary: Bamako, Oct 6 (AMAP)- The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their Russian partners, strengthened and consolidated their operations in Kidal on Tuesday, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the government announced in a statement issued today. According to the document, this reinforcement follows "intense air-land neutralization operations" carried out against a coalition of terrorist groups .

Mali.title: Operation DOUGOUKOLOKO: The FAMa and their Russian partners intensify the offensive in the Eastern and Central theaters
Mali.summary: In line with its previous communiqué, the General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their Russian partners, are continuing the large-scale offensive launched on Tuesday, October 6, 2026 in the Eastern Theater, as part of Operation DOUGOUKOLOKO . This operation aims in particular to strengthen the security of the populations living in this part of the national territory, to guarantee the free movement of people and goods, to secure the borders and to stop the criminal economy developed by the armed terrorist groups (GAT) .

Mali.title: Kidal, Timbuktu, Sofara: Massive FAMa offensive against terrorist strongholds in the North and Centre
Mali.summary: By a new communiqué, the General Staff of the Armed Forces confirmed the continuation of the major offensive started on 6 October 2026 in the Eastern zone, as a continuation of Operation DOUGOUKOLOKO The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their Russian partners, carried out simultaneous strikes on several sectors of the country. This operation aims in particular to strengthen the security of the populations living in this part of the national territory, to guarantee the free movement of people and goods, to secure the borders and to stop the criminal economy developed by armed terrorist groups (GAT).

Mali.title: Aguelhoc: nearly 8,000 displaced people and host families benefit from WFP food stamps
Mali.summary: In Aguelhoc, in the Kidal region, the food situation remains a concern for displaced people and host families. To respond to the emergency, the World Food Programme (WFP), with the support of its partners, launched a food voucher distribution operation in early September. Nearly 8,000 people, or about 1,500 households, benefited from this first phase .

Mali.title: Mali: Fla withdraws from Kidal and leaves the field open to the army
Mali.summary: About 120 vehicles came out of Aéfis, Mali, in the middle of the morning. On board, Malian soldiers, Russian soldiers from the Africa Corps, and fighters from the MSA and Gatia, Tuareg political-military groups integrated into the Malian army (Fama) In a statement issued at midday this Tuesday, the General Staff claims for the first time "to have launched large-scale air-land operations in the Kidal region", with its "Russian partners", in order to "neutralize the armed terrorist groups", "destroy their sanctuaries" and "permanently restore the security of the populations" and their "free movement".

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa intensify their operations in Kidal, Abéïbara, Tin-Assalak and In-Tassik
Mali.summary: From Kidal to Abéïbara, the Malian Armed Forces continue their air-land operations against armed terrorist groups The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) continue their mission with determination as part of Operation DOUGOUKOLOKO . After the launch of this new operational phase on Monday, October 5, 2026 in the Eastern Theater, the General Staff of the Armed Forces reported on new actions carried out in several sectors of the north and center of the country .

Mali.title: Mali.. The army announces the entry of the city of Kidal after the withdrawal of the "Front for the Liberation of Azawad"
Mali.summary: On Tuesday, the Malian army announced its entry into the strategic city of Kidal in the north of the country, following the announcement of the "Front for the Liberation of Azawad" to withdraw from it, about six months after the Front took control of it. AFP quoted a Malian officer as confirming the entry of elements of the Kidal army without facing any resistance, while another indicated that the army arrived in the city "ahead of schedule" .

Mali.title: Kidal: The Fama launch the reconquest operation
Mali.summary: Kidal: Fama launches reconquest operation In Mali, the army announced in a recent press release that it was conducting large-scale air-land operations in the Kidal region, with its Russian partners . This offensive aims to "track down and neutralize armed terrorist groups operating throughout the region, destroy their sanctuaries and supply networks and restore lasting security to the populations and the free movement of people and goods" .

Mali.title: Generative AI Alters the Battlefield in Mali
Mali.summary: There is an information war being fought in Mali online and on social media platforms. A new study outlines how generative artificial intelligence is being used by state, nonstate and foreign entities to push propaganda and misinformation. A September 9 report by the Dakar-based Timbuktu Institute, titled “Algorithms at War: How Generative AI is Reshaping the Malian Conflict,” examined al-Qaida affiliate Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM), the Malian government, Russia’s Africa Corps and the Tuareg separatist group Azawad Liberation Front (FLA).

Mali.title: Mali: Armed forces retake Kidal
Mali.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) regained control of Kidal, a town about 1,530 kilometers north of Bamako, on Tuesday, October 6, 2026, according to several media sources.

Mali.title: Mali.. The army enters Kidal without resistance
Mali.summary: The Malian army and its Russian partners entered the northeastern city of Kidal on the afternoon of Tuesday, October 6, as part of a military operation to retake the strategic city, according to local sources.

Mali.title: The Malian army recaptures the strategic city of Kidal
Mali.summary: In Mali, the army, supported by the Russian paramilitaries of the Africa Corps, has regained control of the city of Kidal, a stronghold of the rebellion in the north of the country. Previously, the Fla, Front for the Liberation of Azawad, had announced a "strategic and controlled withdrawal of its forces" to "preserve human lives" .

Mali.title: Sahel Juntas Depend on Russia, But at What Cost?
Mali.summary: When terrorists attacked Bamako and Niamey earlier this year, the military leaders of Niger and Mali did not turn to their own troops or their newly created Alliance of Sahel States standby force. Instead, they asked for assistance from Africa Corps mercenaries. Security experts say this reveals a dependence on Russia by junta leaders who [...] The post Sahel Juntas Depend on Russia, But at What Cost?

Mali.title: Tuareg rebels withdraw from strategic town of Kidal in northern Mali
Mali.summary: Mali’s Tuareg rebels have announced they are withdrawing from the strategic town of Kidal, in the north of the country. The Azawad Liberation Front (FLA), a coalition formed in 2024 uniting Tuareg and northern separatist factions, said in a statement on Tuesday that it had decided to carry out a “controlled withdrawal” from Kidal six months after capturing the town and amid fresh air strikes by Mali’s military backed by Russian fighters.

Mali.title: Aguelhoc: nearly 8,000 displaced people and host families benefit from WFP food stamps
Mali.summary: In Aguelhoc, in the Kidal region, the food situation remains a concern for displaced people and host families. To respond to the emergency, the World Food Programme (WFP), with the support of its partners, launched a food voucher distribution operation in early September. Nearly 8,000 people, or about 1,500 households, benefited from this first phase .

Mali.title: Mali: the army is increasing pressure on Kidal with large-scale military maneuvers supported by airstrikes in the area
Mali.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, continue their surveillance and security operations as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, in the centre and north of the country.

Mali.title: The Malian army entered the city of Kidal without resistance. The Malian army announced the entry of the strategic city of Kidal in the north of the country, on Tuesday, after the withdrawal of the fighters of the "Front for the Liberation of Azawad" from it, after months of controlling it during a large-scale attack last April.
Mali.summary: The Malian army announced the entry of the strategic city of Kidal in the north of the country, on Tuesday, after the withdrawal of the fighters of the "Front for the Liberation of Azawad" from it, months after they took control of it during a large-scale attack last April. Two Malian officers confirmed to AFP the arrival of the troops in the city. One said that a military convoy left the town of Anevis on Tuesday morning and entered Kidal shortly before 1pm local time, adding: "Without encountering any resistance.

Mali.title: Malian army enters strategic northern city of Kidal
Mali.summary: The Malian army said it had entered the strategic northern city of Kidal after Tuareg-led separatists announced the withdrawal of their forces as the military advanced. Two Malian military officers told AFP on Tuesday that government forces had entered the city without encountering resistance. A military convoy left the town of Anefis earlier in the day and “entered Kidal shortly before 1:00 pm,” one officer said.

Mali.title: Mali: the army recaptures the strategic city of Kidal, deserted by the rebels
Mali.summary: L’armée malienne, appuyée par les paramilitaires russes de Africa Corps, a repris mardi 6 octobre le contrôle de la ville stratégique de Kidal, désertée par les rebelles touareg qui ont effectué « un repli stratégique ». Cette reprise de Kidal, bastion de la rébellion, représente une victoire pour l’armée malienne, qui en avait été chassée en avril par le Front de libération de l’Azawad (FLA) et ses alliés djihadistes du Groupe de soutien à l’islam et aux musulmans (JNIM), affilié à Al-Qaida.

Mali.title: Mali: Kidal falls back into the hands of the FAMa, the Fla announces a "strategic withdrawal"
Mali.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their Russian partners from Africa Corps, regained control of Kidal, in northern Mali, on Tuesday, October 6, 2026. The Azawad Liberation Front (Fla), which had controlled the city since April, announced its “strategic and controlled retreat” According to several sources consulted on Tuesday, Malian forces, accompanied by their Russian partners, entered the city of Kidal after the withdrawal of Fla fighters.

Mali.title: The withdrawal of «separatists» from Kidal.. The beginning of the lifting of the siege of Bamako with Russian support
Mali.summary: An important field development in Mali after the withdrawal of the separatist Front for the Liberation of Azawad from the strategic city of Kidal, which may ease pressure on the capital, Bamako. In a statement on Tuesday, the Front said it was "systematically withdrawing" from a strategic town in the north that it had seized with elements linked to the al-Qaeda terrorist organization during attacks across the country six months ago.

Mali.title: Image Published on October 6, 2026 Africa Mali: the army retakes the strategic city of Kidal, deserted by the rebels The Malian army, supported by the Russian paramilitaries of Africa Corps, on Tuesday regained control of the strategic city of Kidal, deserted by…
Mali.summary: General view of a school damaged by fighting in Kidal, May 9, 2026 The Malian army, supported by Russian Africa Corps paramilitaries, regained control on Tuesday of the strategic town of Kidal, deserted by Tuareg rebels who have made a "strategic withdrawal" . This recapture of Kidal, a stronghold of the rebellion, represents a victory for the Malian army, which had been driven out in April by the Azawad Liberation Front (Fla) and its jihadist allies of the Support Group for Islam and Muslims (JNIM), affiliated with Al-Qaeda .

Mali.title: Image Published on October 6, 2026 Africa Mali: The Malian army now occupies Kidal after the withdrawal of the Tuareg rebels of the Fla The Tuareg independence rebels of the Front de libération de l 'Azawad (Fla) have announced that they have withdrawn their forces from Kidal, in northern Mali,...
Mali.summary: The Tuareg independence rebels of the Azawad Liberation Front (Fla) announced that they had withdrawn their forces from Kidal, in northern Mali, in the face of army operations. They had taken control of this strategic city at the end of April, now occupied by the forces of military power. In this file photo taken on Sunday, November 24, 2013, the Malian army patrols the streets of Gao, in northern Mali .

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Keniéba: A man apprehended with 3 doors of the Museum of Archaeology and 75 packages of 1000 dollars
Mali.summary: Kéniéba, October 6 (AMAP) The Kéniéba Gendarmerie Territorial Brigade apprehended a man in possession of three wooden doors, parts of the Museum of Archaeology and Ethnology of Mali and a safe containing 75 packets of one thousand (1000) dollars each to be laundered, learned AMAP from a security source . The Commander of the Territorial Gendarmerie Brigade of Kéniéba , Falaye Fodé Keïta and his men grappled with a person from the commune of Faléa, in the circle of Kéniéba, working in the field of money laundering and trafficking in art objects .

Mali.title: Kidal: the Malian army regains control of the city
Mali.summary: The Malian army regained control of Kidal, in northern Mali, on Tuesday, October 6. The Malian Armed Forces entered the city without resistance. This return comes more than five months after the capture of Kidal by the Azawad Liberation Front (Fla), allied to the Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims (JNIM) Several security sources confirm this entry of the Fama into Kidal.

Mali.title: Bamako admits bombing Tin Zouatine.. and"Azawad" withdraws from Kidal
Mali.summary: Bamako Acknowledges Bombing of Tin Zouatine Near Algeria Border, Azawad Withdraws from Kidal - The Malian army, with the support of the Russian "African Legion", launched a military operation to retake Kidal and pursue the armed groups, which resulted in the destruction of equipment and the killing of militants.

Mali.title: Mali: Launch of major air-land operations in the Kidal region
Mali.summary: As part of the rehabilitation of Operation DOUGOUKOLOKO, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) and their Russian partners have launched large-scale air-land operations in the Kidal region. This military offensive is primarily aimed at tracking down and neutralizing armed terrorist groups operating throughout the region It also aims to destroy their sanctuaries as well as their supply networks, in order to sustainably restore the security of the populations and guarantee the free movement of people and goods.

Mali.title: Mali: the Tuareg rebellion of the Fla announces its withdrawal from Kidal in the face of army operations
Mali.summary: The Tuareg independence rebels of the Azawad Liberation Front (Fla), who had taken control at the end of April of the strategic Malian locality of Kidal, announced on Tuesday that they had made a "strategic withdrawal" of their forces in the face of army operations to retake this northern city . The loss of control of Kidal at the end of April had been a real slap in the face for the military in power.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Sudan: at least 10 civilians killed in attack attributed to SRF in Western Kordofan
Mali.summary: Bamako, Oct. 6 (AMAP) At least ten civilians were killed and several others injured in an attack attributed to the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) on the village of Abu Ajal in West Kordofan state, the Dar Hamar Emergency Committee, a local aid group, said Tuesday. According to a statement from the group, the FSR attacked the village, located in the rural area southeast of En Nahud, killing “more than 10 civilians” and injuring a large number of residents.

Mali.title: Mali army says has entered key city of Kidal, abandoned by rebels: military sources
Mali.summary: By continuing to browse our site you agree to our use of cookies, revised Privacy Policy and Terms of Use. You can change your cookie settings through your browser.

Mali.title: Mali: Fla announces strategic withdrawal of Kidal from the army
Mali.summary: Mali: the Fla announces a strategic withdrawal of Kidal against the army Mali: the Tuareg rebellion of the Fla announces its withdrawal from Kidal against the army's operation. The Tuareg independence rebels of the Azawad Liberation Front (Fla), who had taken control of the strategic Malian town of Kidal at the end of April, announced on Tuesday that they were carrying out a "strategic withdrawal" of their forces in the face of army operations to recapture this city from the north.

Mali.title: Kidal taken over by the FAMa: Mali is writing a new page in its military history
Mali.summary: Kidal: the Malian army retakes the city, the FAMa move to a new stage of operation Dougoukoloko A historic day for Mali Tuesday, October 6, 2026 will remain as a particularly strong date in the Malian collective memory After several days of intense military operations in the Kidal region, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) have regained position in the city, marking another major step in the restoration of state authority over this strategic part of the national territory .

Mali.title: Malian army and Russian fighters retake key city of Kidal, abandoned by rebels
Mali.summary: The Malian army said it has entered the strategic northern city of Kidal, which was captured in April by Tuareg separatists who announced their withdrawal earlier Tuesday as the military advanced. "We have just arrived in Kidal ahead of schedule," a staff officer told AFP, with a second officer confirming the arrival.

Mali.title: Mali: the FAMa regain control of Kidal, the Fla speaks of "strategic withdrawal"
Mali.summary: The Front de libération de l 'Azawad (Fla) announced its withdrawal from Kidal in northern Mali on October 6, 2026, as the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) regained control of the city. The independence movement speaks of a "strategic and controlled withdrawal" of its forces in press release No.022/BE/Fla/2026, signed in Kidal by its spokesman, Mohamed Elmaouloud Ramadane .

Mali.title: Mali: Fla withdraws from Kidal and leaves the field open to the army
Mali.summary: Mali: le FLA se retire de Kidal et laisse le champ libre à l'armée Au Mali, l'armée malienne et ses partenaires russes sont entrés à Kidal mardi 6 octobre après-midi. L'armée avait renforcé ses positions à Anéfis et Aguelhoc pendant le week-end, dans le cadre d'une offensive pour reconquérir cette ville du Nord, dont les indépendantistes du Front de libération de l'Azawad (FLA) et les jihadistes du (Groupe de soutien à l'islam et aux musulmans (Jnim, lié à al-Qaïda) s'étaient emparés en avril dernier.

Mali.title: Recapture of Kidal by the Malian army: how Assimi Goïta prepared the offensive
Mali.summary: The Malian Armed Forces and their Russian allies from Africa Corps regained control of Kidal on Tuesday, October 6, just over five months after the fall of this strategic northern city to the Fla and Jnim. Published today at 15:49, modified at 17:40 Reading: 3 minutes . File generated on The Malian army, supported by the Russian military of Africa Corps, took over this Tuesday, October 6, the city of Kidal in northern Mali.

Mali.title: koutiala, kidal...
Mali.summary: Several terrorists were neutralized and their logistics bases destroyed. It emerges from these announcements that, on Sunday, October 4, 2026, the use of precise intelligence made it possible to locate, 10 kilometers south-east of Tiéré, in the Koutiala Region, a terrorist base housing war materials and logistics, including vehicles and a fuel depot . According to the security source, after confirming the information collected and assessing the situation, the position was targeted and processed successfully.

Mali.title: Kidal: the Fla leaves the city against the backdrop of the FAMa offensive
Mali.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) and their allies have taken a position in the city of Kidal, as part of an air-land operation launched several days ago in the region According to the information provided, these operations are aimed in particular at the armed groups present in the region, their supply networks and their positions, with the stated objective of strengthening security and facilitating the free movement of people and goods In a statement released on Tuesday, the Azawad Liberation Front (Fla) announced the withdrawal of its elements from Kidal and reported the presence of Malian forces in the city.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Kidal: a vast air-land operation launched
Mali.summary: Kidal, October 6 (AMAP) The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) and their Russian partners have launched large-scale air-land operations in the Kidal region, as part of the rehabilitation of the operation Dougoukoloko, according to a statement from the General Staff of the Armed Forces published on Tuesday. These operations are aimed at tracking down and neutralizing armed terrorist groups active in the region, destroying their sanctuaries and their supply networks and to restore the safety of the population in the long term.

Mali.title: OFENSIVE AEROTERESTRE IN the NORTH: The Malian army inflicts a major setback on terrorist groups in Kidal and Tinzaouatène
Mali.summary: In the theater of military operations in the north of Mali, the momentum is accelerating and the pressure is not falling back.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa and their Russian partners intensify air-land operations in the Kidal region
Mali.summary: As part of the rehabilitation of the Dougoukoloko operation, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), in coordination with their Russian partners, have launched new large-scale air-land operations in the Kidal region . The stated objective of the General Staff of the Armed Forces is clear: to increase pressure on armed terrorist groups, dismantle their sanctuaries and supply networks, while contributing to the sustainable restoration of security and the free movement of people and goods .

Mali.title: Kidal: Massive air-land offensive by the FAMa and their Russian allies against terrorist strongholds
Mali.summary: Kidal: Massive air-terrestrial offensive by the FAMa and their Russian allies against terrorist strongholds The Malian armed forces and their Russian allies have begun major air-terrestrial maneuvers in Kidal, as part of the readjustment of Operation DOUGOUKOLOKO, according to the General Staff of the Armed Forces . These operations are aimed at tracking down and neutralizing armed terrorist groups operating throughout the region, destroying their sanctuaries and supply networks, as well as sustainably restoring the security of the populations and the free movement of people and goods .

Mali.title: Malian army begins' large-scale 'operations in Kidal
Mali.summary: The Malian army announced the start of large-scale air and ground operations in the northeastern region of Kidal, with the support of the Russian Africa Corps. He explained in a statement today, Tuesday, that the operation aims to track and neutralize armed groups operating throughout the region, destroy their strongholds and supply networks, permanently restore security to the population and ensure the free movement of people and property.

Mali.title: Mali: Fama neutralizes several terrorists in Tinzaouatène
Mali.summary: In a statement published yesterday, Monday, October 5, 2026, the General Staff of the Armed Forces informs that air-land operations have taken place in the Kidal sector. Several positions of armed terrorist groups have occasionally been located and hit in Tinzaouatène and its surroundings "The provisional balance sheet of these operations shows many terrorists neutralized as well as the destruction of a dozen pick-up vehicles, a truck, several motorcycles and many equipment" .

Mali.source: Timbuktu Institute (African Center for Peace Studies)
Mali.title: Burkina Faso : Captain Traoré Pushes the Sovereign…
Mali.summary: Sacré-Coeur 3 – BP 15177 CP 10700 Dakar Fann – SENEGAL. +221 33 827 34 91 / +221 77 637 73 15 contact@timbuktu-institute.org Timbuktu Institute - Week 4 September 2026 News in Burkina Faso was marked by the strengthening of the military-industrial apparatus. Mali.title: Burkina Faso: Captain Traoré pushes the logic...
Mali.summary: Sacré-Coeur 3 – BP 15177 CP 10700 Dakar Fann – SENEGAL. +221 33 827 34 91 / +221 77 637 73 15 contact@timbuktu-institute.org Timbuktu Institute - Week 4 September 2026 Current events in Burkina Faso have been marked by the strengthening of the military industrial apparatus. Indeed, Captain Traoré announced the production of some 300 vehicles in just 10 months .

Mali.title: AES: how jihadists learned to strike with drones
Mali.summary: JNIM, a jihadist group linked to Al-Qaeda, claimed responsibility for an ambush on 28 September 2026 against a convoy of the Malian army and the Russian Africa Corps, near Niono, in central Mali. Drone fire opened the attack before the ground assault, and at least four Russians were killed according to local sources . This is clearly an evolution that the armies of the Confederation of Sahel States (AES), which brings together Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, have not been able to stop: in three years, armed groups in the region have gone from simple reconnaissance drones to strike weapons.

Mali.title: Mali's military offensive has begun in the Kidal region
Mali.summary: Malian social networks favorable to the regime relayed Monday images, filmed the same day, of drone strikes on the city of Tinzawaten, on the Algerian border. These strikes herald the start of the offensive to recapture Kidal and the northern region that was announced for the end of the rainy season . Tinzawaten was until now a military sanctuary of the Azawad Liberation Front, the main target of the offensive to reconquer the north.

Mali.title: Mali: the army recaptures the strategic city of Kidal, deserted by the Bamako rebels (AFP)
Mali.summary: The Malian army, supported by Russian Africa Corps paramilitaries, regained control on Tuesday of the strategic town of Kidal, deserted by Tuareg rebels who have made a "strategic withdrawal" . This recapture of Kidal, a stronghold of the rebellion, represents a victory for the Malian army, which had been driven out in April by the Azawad Liberation Front (Fla) and its jihadist allies of the Support Group for Islam and Muslims (JNIM), affiliated with Al-Qaeda .

Burkina Faso.title: In Burkina Faso, release of a hundred supporters of Imam Kindo "trained" by the military
Burkina Faso.summary: In Burkina Faso, dozens of supporters of the Burkinabe Sunni preacher Mohamad Ishaq Kindo were released following the release of a hundred followers of Imam Kindo who were "trained" by the military, arrested four months ago and "straightened out" in a military camp.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina: decrease in road accidents in August and September
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso recorded a decline in traffic accidents, injuries and fatalities in August and September 2026, with the lowest monthly levels of the year, according to Ministry of Security statistics released Monday. In September, 1,450 accidents were recorded, resulting in 1,055 injuries and 69 deaths, compared to 1,516 accidents, 1,347 injuries and 79 deaths in August In the first nine months of 2026, the country recorded 15,853 traffic accidents, resulting in 12,858 injuries and 910 deaths, the ministry said.

Niger.title: Algeria: President Tebboune discusses relations with Niger and Mali
Niger.summary: Members of the Alliance of Sahel States (AES), Niger and Mali have warmed up their relations with Algeria after the Tinzaouatène incident in April 2025. Niamey leads several projects with Algiers in areas such as mining, energy, etc. In his periodic interview broadcast on Saturday, October 3 on Algerian television channels, President Abdelmadjid Tebboune said that his country supports the development of Niger.

Niger.title: Article reserved for subscribers Analysis. In the Sahel, Algeria has emerged from its doctrine of non-intervention Middle East Eye
Niger.summary: At the request of the Nigerien authorities, Algeria announced, on August 30, the deployment of four Su-30 fighters, a tanker plane and a transport plane to help its neighbor. This support mission was launched in the aftermath of an abortive coup in Niger, a country led by General Abdourahamane Tiani since his own coup in July 2023. The country, which shares a 950-kilometre border with southern Algeria, is shaken by renewed tensions.

Mali.title: Illegal gold panning in Mali: A destructive activity of the eco-system
Mali.summary: Illegal and mechanized gold mining in Mali poses a major ecological, economic and social threat that requires an urgent takeover of sovereignty over our resources. A vital sector: More than 400,000 people work directly in artisanal gold panning, supporting millions of Malians in the face of unemployment and poverty Mechanized drift: The arrival of heavy machinery (excavators, bulldozers) and dredges on riverbeds (such as the Falémé and Niger) has transformed a subsistence activity into unregulated industrial looting.

Mali.title: Malian army under General Goïta: A powerful tool of sovereignty up to the challenges!
Mali.summary: A concrete transformative work, with revolutionary essence, has been accomplished on the national defense tool in order to respond, with the greatest efficiency, to the immense security challenges generated by the current geopolitical context in Mali The Malian Army, by its irrepressible firepower, heroically stood up to the worst threats of the imperialist powers by bringing down the thunderbolt of hell on the enemies in the service of their subversive plans .

Mali.title: From Wagner to Africa Corps: the Russian presence in the Sahel in question
Mali.summary: Ouestfanews – Russia's military presence in West Africa divides West African specialists. While some are satisfied with the saving role of the Russian paramilitaries, others believe that insecurity is increasing in the region and denounce their behavior as brutal. "Without the Russian presence, Bamako (would have) fallen".

Mali.title: More than 643 fuel trucks arrive in Bamako under the tight protection of the Malian army
Mali.summary: A convoy of more than 643 fuel transport vehicles arrived in the Malian capital of Bamako, during the night of Friday, October 2 to Saturday, October 3, 2026, under the tight protection of the Malian army. The trucks, which arrived in the capital in the early hours of Saturday morning, began unloading and fueling operations around 7 a.m.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Koutiala: positions of armed terrorist groups targeted and hit by FAMa
Mali.summary: Bamako, October 04 (AMAP) The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, targeted and struck, on Saturday, October 3, 2026, several entrenchment points of armed terrorist groups, located about 40 kilometers south of Koutiala, says a statement from the General Staff of the Armed Forces . According to the same source, the exploitation of precise intelligence has made it possible to locate several positions housing armed terrorist groups as well as war materials, including many armed vehicles.

Mali.title: Military Command: Lines move after April 25
Mali.summary: The appointments of May 29, 2026 reorganize several sensitive positions in the Malian military chain. They come after an offensive that changed Bamako's security priorities. This change is not limited to a circulation of names in the military apparatus .

Mali.title: Road safety: A "Guissé Trans" bus overturns on the Bla-San axis, one dead and 30 injured
Mali.summary: A serious traffic accident occurred on Saturday, October 3, 2026 on National Road 6 (RN6), on the Bla-San axis. A bus of the company "Guissé Trans", from Gouma to Bamako, overturned while carrying 65 passengers and livestock .

Mali.title: San: Army fends off attack despite casualties
Mali.summary: An attack was perpetrated Sunday, August 9 against the grip of the 23rd San Infantry Regiment. The General Staff of the Armed Forces claims to have regained control of the camp after fighting that resulted in casualties in the military ranks and among the attackers According to the statement issued Monday, August 10, the attack began around 5:30 a.m. and mobilized heavy machine guns, kamikaze drones, charge-dropping drones as well as two armored vehicles.

Mali.title: Under FAMa fire: Several terrorist logistics bases destroyed in Tessalit, Nampala and Sofara
Mali.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their permanent operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko . On Wednesday, September 30, 2026, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible to locate, in the immediate outskirts of Tessalit, several entrenchment points of armed terrorist groups housing war and logistics equipment.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: The FAMa destroy a terrorist base with armed vehicles south of Koutiala
Mali.summary: In a statement, the General Staff of the Armed Forces said that the operations to secure the territory, carried out as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, are continuing. The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, conducted a new targeted strike on Saturday, October 3, 2026 On Saturday, October 3, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible to locate, 40 kilometers south of Koutiala, several points of entrenchment of armed terrorist groups.

Mali.title: Koutiala: Neutralization of terrorist shelters and armed vehicles by FAMa
Mali.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their permanent operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko . On Saturday, October 3, 2026, the use of precise information made it possible to locate, 40 kilometers south of Koutiala, several entrenchment points of armed terrorist groups housing war materials including many armed vehicles.

Mali.title: Kidal: six wounded evacuated to Gao, the Fla speaks of released soldiers
Mali.summary: AT this TIME The International Committee of the Red Cross specifies that it organized this evacuation after obtaining security guarantees from all parties to the conflict. Its press release does not give the identity of the persons transferred and does not specify their status. This discretion corresponds to his mandate as a neutral intermediary and the confidential nature of his dialogue with the belligerents On the same day, the Azawad Liberation Front announced that it had entrusted six wounded Malian soldiers, captured in previous clashes, to the ICRC.

Mali.title: Targeted financial sanctions: Bamako expands its security pressure tool
Mali.summary: AT THIS TIME The text provides for the freezing of the property and economic resources of the persons concerned for six renewable months. It is based on national texts relating to the fight against money laundering, the financing of terrorism and the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction . The grievances are formulated identically for the twelve names: alleged support for JNIM and the Azawad Liberation Front, promotion or apology of terrorism, criminal association and facilitation of terrorist acts.

Mali.title: BAMEX 2025: A strategic strengthening of military cooperation in Mali
Mali.summary: This exhibition, which takes place in two phases, began with an exhibition at the Bamako Exhibition Park and continues with practical demonstrations at the Boubacar Sada Sy Center in Koulikoro. It offers a unique opportunity to discover state-of-the-art equipment, presented by more than 30 international companies, mainly Turkish, but also Russian and Chinese .

Mali.title: FAMa: positions of armed groups targeted in Abéïbara and near Sévaré
Mali.summary: AT THIS MOMENT The Malian army continues its air operations against the armed groups active in the country. In a statement issued Wednesday, August 26, the General Staff of the Armed Forces reported a series of strikes in the north and center of Mali, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko According to the military hierarchy, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible, on Monday, August 24, to locate several regroupment points of armed terrorist groups in Abéïbara, in the Kidal region.

Mali.title: 65th anniversary of the Malian Army: the nation pays tribute to its forces
Mali.summary: Mali commemorated this Tuesday the 65th anniversary of the creation of its national army, on the occasion of an official ceremony presided over by the President of the Transition, Army General Assimi Goïta, Supreme Chief of the Armed Forces .

Mali.title: In Mali, from the Wagner Group to Africa Corps, the continuity of impunity?
Mali.summary: The transfer of Wagner's mercenaries to the military of Africa Corps, two Russian organizations, did not put an end to the abuses against civilians.

Mali.title: Senou: A dangerous network of inoperable motorcycle robbers
Mali.summary: FIGHT AGAINST DELINQUENCY and CRIME: As part of the strengthening of security, the Senou Police Station, headed by Chief Police Commissioner Cheickna SOW, arrested three (03) individuals suspected of being members of a criminal network on 19 September 2026 The operation, carried out by the Research Brigade, follows the denunciation of several cases of motorcycle theft in the peripheral districts of Bamako and the surrounding localities, sometimes followed by robberies.

Mali.title: Mali: Evidence of War Crimes
Mali.summary: Members of Mali’s armed forces working together with personnel from the Wagner Group committed war crimes, including the murder and torture of civilians, during joint operations between 2023 and 2025, Amnesty International said in a new report.

Mali.title: Mali: Report Accuses Army and Wagner of War Crimes
Mali.summary: - Civilians killed in joint military operations - Civilians tortured to death in detention; others beaten, simulated drowning and electrocuted - Fulani, Arabs and Tuaregs targeted Members of the Malian armed forces acting with members of the Wagner group committed war crimes, including killings and torture of civilians during operations carried out between 2023 and 2025, Amnesty International said in a new report.

Mali.title: Niger: after the mutiny, Tiani tightens its grip on the…
Mali.summary: Sacré-Coeur 3 – BP 15177 CP 10700 Dakar Fann – SENEGAL. +221 33 827 34 91 / +221 77 637 73 15 contact@timbuktu-institute.org Timbuktu Institute - Week 3 September 2026 Niger faced one of its first internal challenges since the arrival of General Abdourahamane Tiani in power in 2023 with the coup attempt at the end of August 2026 . With the support of Africa Corps, the Nigerien army managed to regain control of strategic sites very quickly.

Mali.title: Crash of the Air Algérie flight AH5017 in Mali, the judgment expected in Paris
Mali.summary: Twelve years after the crash of Air Algérie flight AH5017, judgment is expected on Monday, September 28, 2026 in Paris. The aircraft, operated by the Spanish company Swiftair and chartered by Air Algérie, crashed on 24 July 2014 near Gossi, in the Timbuktu region. All 116 people on board, including a Malian, had perished.

Burkina Faso.title: Government exhibition: the achievements of the Ministry of Security presented
Burkina Faso.summary: The Minister of Security, Mahamoudou Sana, took stock of his department on Friday, October 2, 2026, in Ouagadougou, as part of the government exhibition. The Minister of Security, Mahamoudou Sana, lent himself to the accountability exercise, initiated as part of the government exhibition. The dialogue with the people took the form of a mini-conference .

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: the Patriotic Support Fund exceeds 250 billion FCFA
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso's Patriotic Support Fund (FSP) has mobilized more than 250 billion CFA francs since January, according to the Government Information Service. This amount exceeds the annual target of 200 billion CFA francs by 25% and shows an increase of 75% compared to the same period in 2025 . Prime Minister Rimtalba Jean Emmanuel Ouédraogo called for continued resource mobilization while strengthening transparency in their management.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso.
Burkina Faso.summary: April 07, 2023 Salafi-Jihadi Movement Weekly Update, April 5, 2023 Data Cutoff: April 5, 2023, at 10 a.m. Contributor: Will Harvey Key Takeaways: Iraq and Syria. The Iraqi Kurdish Peshmerga and Iraqi Security Forces (ISF) will likely remain unable to address coordination issues on the line of control between Iraqi Kurdistan and federal Iraq, likely enabling ISIS to continue its low-grade insurgency in Iraq’s disputed internal boundaries (DIB).

Burkina Faso.title: ECOWAS – ESA: Cooperating against terrorism
Burkina Faso.summary: Meeting on 19 July 2026 in Lungi, Sierra Leone, ECOWAS decided to deepen the dialogue with the Alliance of Sahel States with a view to a security cooperation mechanism. An orientation to reconnect regional efforts against a cross-border threat. On the ground, armed groups cross borders and use regional networks to source weapons, motorcycles, fuel or drones .

Burkina Faso.title: 6 Burkina Faso: Night of the People's Progressive Revolution - The main achievements presented to the population
Burkina Faso.summary: The Night of the People's Progressive Revolution (RPP) was an opportunity to present the main achievements made during the four years of Captain Ibrahim Traoré. From the reconquest of the territory to diplomacy, via agriculture, health and culture, everything demonstrates that Burkina Faso is resolutely committed to its sovereignty and development . In addition to the tribute to the Defence and Security Forces (FDS) and the Volunteers for the Defence of the Fatherland (VDP), the first edition of the night of the People's Progressive Revolution (RPP) was a real moment of accountability.

Burkina Faso.title: 29 September 2026 - 14:21 Ouagadougou: a cannabis trafficking network dismantled, 86 kg seized
Burkina Faso.summary: The Anti-Drug Unit of the Judicial Police Directorate has put an end to the activities of a cannabis trafficking and sales network in Ouagadougou. This structured group also engaged in the sale of adulterated beverages, contraband cigarettes and psychotropic products. According to the police, the goods were transported from a neighboring country, by public or personal transport vehicles .

Niger.title: Defence and Security: SDF adapts to new threats, gains victories and anticipates challenges on the ground
Niger.summary: Terrorist armed groups, employing mercenaries, with an imperialist agenda of destabilization, losing their bearings, are trying everything for the sake of it. Suicidal shrapnel shattered, such as attempts to attack air bases 101 and 401, and the terminal of Diori Hamani airport, in Niamey and Tahoua, the use of improvised explosive devices (IEDs) and kamikaze drones, they face a proven professionalism of the Nigerien Defence and Security Forces (FDS), after decisive strategic and tactical reforms.

Niger.title: Events in Niamey: Algerian military aircraft dispatched to Niger to counter an attempted coup, assures the Algerian President
Niger.summary: In his last periodic interview broadcast Saturday evening on the national channels, the Algerian president returned to the decision of Algiers to send military aircraft to Niger, following the events of Niamey, from 28 to 29 August According to Abdelmadjid Tebboune, the four (04) Su-30 fighters were deployed to the main air base of the Nigerien army, on the outskirts of the capital, to face a coup attempt "The coup attempt in Niger took place the day after the visit of the Prime Minister of Niger to Algeria, which we consider an attempt to provoke us," explained the Algerian head of state, who assured that "some…

Niger.title: Niger: the mutiny that targeted the heart of power
Niger.summary: RIGHT NOW The events of August 29th go far beyond a barracks protest. They establish an armed mutiny directed against several strategic sites, but the public elements do not yet allow to reconstitute an organized project of seizure of power Three days after the shots that shook Niamey, the Nigerien authorities are once again in control of Air Base 101, Diori-Hamani International Airport, the presidential palace and the other targeted sites.

Niger.title: Agadez: the Regional Security Council examines the security situation and recommends strengthening the existing system
Niger.summary: The Governor of the Region of Agadez, Major General Ibra Boulama Issa, chaired, on Wednesday, March 11, 2026, the regular meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS), held in the usual meeting room in the Governorate of Agadez . This meeting allowed the members of this forum to examine the security situation in the region and identify the measures necessary to strengthen the protection of populations and their property.

Niger.title: Agadez: Seizure of a significant amount of cocaine estimated at more than 2.5 billion CFA francs
Niger.summary: Agadez, Sept 29 (ANP) – The defense and security forces have successfully seized a significant amount of cocaine in the Agadez region. With an estimated value of 2,570,610,000 CFA francs, this seizure was presented to the press on Tuesday, September 29, 2026 at the Regional Directorate of the National Police .

Niger.title: Agadez: more than 50 kg of cocaine and other narcotics seized in Arlit
Niger.summary: The National Gendarmerie intercepted more than 50 kilograms of cocaine as well as other narcotic products during a security operation conducted in the department of Arlit. The market value of the seized drug is estimated at more than two billion CFA francs. The products were handed over to the regional branch of the Central Office for the Suppression of Illicit Drug Trafficking (OCRTIS) in Agadez .

Niger.title: Agadez: Ordinary meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS)
Niger.summary: Agadez, Sept. 24 (ANP) – The Governor of the Region of Agadez, Major General Ibra Boulama Issa chaired, on Thursday, September 24, 2026, an ordinary meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS). Several items were on the agenda of this meeting, including the assessment of the security situation in the region .

Niger.title: Pregabalin trafficking in Agadez: Two individuals arrested, 6,900 capsules seized by OCRTIS
Niger.summary: On 22 September 2026, the regional branch of the Central Office for the Suppression of Illicit Drug Trafficking (OCRTIS) in Agadez arrested two individuals suspected of being involved in pregabalin trafficking. The operation resulted in the seizure of 6,900 capsules of this highly risky substance, discovered in the hands of the first suspect and at the home of the second .
